comment: TEMPLATE. Memory benchmarks are inherently personal — they name your own sessions — so the authors' real query set is not published. Freeze your own: pick ~10 questions you know the answer to, find the extracted session file(s) in ~/.rooo-context-retriever/memory/ that contain each answer, and list their filename prefixes under expect. Then run: npx tsx src/run010.ts. Our frozen set scored: best-chunk cosine 9/11 (82%) MRR 0.545; ACT-R recency decay tied or worse; query-blind newest-first 2/11.
